claim: In the matching retail DLL, instance PlayerController_AI.EndFallSubmission_Won() (0x06005025) has raw MethodDef row 70f82f000000810013400a00db490000de3a, RVA 0x002FF870, signature blob 200002 (parameterless Boolean return), raw ImplFlags 0x0000 and MethodAttributes 0x0081, local signature token 0x11000C98 with blob 070212a78808, and an exact 180-byte fat-header body SHA-256 e43bed886326ec138725263c219956e6246d4a71aaaf3553d40b7c16ed2b7b89. The two locals are Player and Int32. The body obtains PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(this.PlObj.TargetPlIdx) through canonical FACT-0109 and stores the returned Player local. External UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit gates that local; a false conversion returns false. If this.PlObj.isPinfallAtk is false, this.PlObj.isSubmissionAtk must be true or endFallTimer is reset to raw -1 and the method returns false. The target Player must have isLose true or isKO true; otherwise endFallTimer is reset to raw -1 and the method returns false. When those gates pass, a negative endFallTimer is initialized to raw 60 and the method returns false. Otherwise endFallTimer is decremented by raw 1; while the decremented value is greater than raw 0 the method returns false. When the decremented value is <= 0, endFallTimer is written raw -1, inherited PlayerController.padPush is written raw 32, and the method returns true. Exact matching-DLL scanning finds two direct MethodDef-token references: PlayerController_AI.Process_AfterMatchEnd at IL+0x003E and PlayerController_AI.Update at IL+0x00AE.
